assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The canonical input lacks its independently known Git Safety block, detecting an empty or wrong input before an absence claim.
Restore the retired fleet heading in the constant and mapping; the independent canonical blocks lack it and implement/test redden, as recorded in negative-control.log.
Restore the retired committed compute digest; the literal new-heading assertion fails.
Restore the retired committed compute digest or append its heading; the forbidden-heading assertion fails.
Keep the new heading but drop a canonical paragraph from the committed digest; independent canonical block membership fails.

findings.text: blocking: Every added regression case obtains CANONICAL from the operator's ~/.agents/AGENTS.md and skips when it is absent; this violates the repository's test-isolation rule, makes committed-code outcomes depend on mutable home state, and removes all new regression coverage on a clean host; use an independently pinned repository fixture for these assertions and keep the live canonical check as an explicit operational gate, without deriving expected headings from SECTION_MAP.
